result.evidence: c1: The text is Russian, does not repeat the fragment, and the opening "В обоих случаях" joins plausibly. It runs about 80 words, at the upper edge of the 50–80 range. There is a typo: "хоть какой то" is missing its hyphen. c2: It misreads the mechanism. It treats the examples as chaotic client requirements ("никто не знает, что именно нужно делать", "пожелания противоречат друг другу") rather than as a critique of placeholder case-study writing such as "такая-то" and "то-се". It never explains what such templates do wrong. c3: There are no invented numbers or personal anecdotes. However, it drifts into generic project-management advice ("зафиксировать все эти противоречия и честно показать их клиенту") and ends on a rounded closing line ("придется вернуться к тому же самому вопросу") instead of developing the point. c4: It loses the dry, ironic, instructional voice and replaces it with a generic "ты" narrative. Phrasing is wordy ("И не о том тут речь", "к тому же самому вопросу о том, что же"), and the tangent does not develop the thread about placeholder vagueness.
